1                     UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT                       
2                          DISTRICT OF NEVADA                            
3                                  * * *                                 

4   BARTELL RANCH LLC, et al.,        Case Nos.   3:21-CV-0080-MMD-CLB   
                                                          3:21-CV-0103-MMD-CLB 
5                             Plaintiff,                                 
                                              ORDER GRANTING             
6        v.                                 MOTIONS TO WITHDRAW          

7   ESTER MCCULLOUGH, et al.,                  [ECF No. 160, 163]        

8                          Defendants.                                   

9                                                                        
10        Before the Court is Julie Cavanaugh-Bill’s (“Cavanaugh-Bill”) motion to withdraw 
11   as local counsel for two Defendants: 1) Reno Sparks Indian Colony (“RSIC”), and 2) Atsa 
12   koodakuh wyh Nuwu People of Red Mountain (“Red Mountain”). (ECF No. 160.) Also 
13   before the Court is William Falk (“Falk”) and Terry Lodge’s (“Lodge”) motion to withdraw 
14   as to Red Mountain only. (ECF No. 163.) No opposition to either motion was filed. The 
15   Court will address each motion in turn.                              
16        Julie Cavanaugh-Bill – ECF No. 160                              
17        As to RSIC, a substitution of counsel was filed withdrawing Cavanaugh-Bill as local 
18   counsel for RSIC only. (ECF No. 172.) Therefore, the motion to withdraw as it relates to 
19   RSIC is DENIED as moot. The Court notes that the Clerk erroneously assumed that 
20   newly substituted counsel, Vicky Oldenburg (“Oldenburg”), was also substituting in as 
21   local counsel for Red Mountain. The Clerk shall correct this error on the docket sheet to 
22   remove Oldenburg as local counsel for Red Mountain.                  
23        As to Red Mountain, Cavanaugh-Bill’s motion to withdraw as local counsel is 
24   GRANTED. (ECF No. 160.)                                              
25        William Falk and Terry Lodge – ECF No. 163                      
26        Falk and Lodge moved to withdraw as counsel for Red Mountain only. (ECF No. 
27   163.) No opposition was filed and counsel certified they served the motion to withdraw on 
       People of Red Mountain. (/d.) The motion to withdraw is GRANTED. Falk and/or Lodge 
     shall immediately file a notice with the last known address of Daranda Hinkey, Secretary 
3|    of the People of Red Mountain, so the Clerk may add this information to the docket sheet 
4 |  for further service of documents and orders in this case. The Clerk shall then MAIL a copy 
5 |  of this order to the last known address of Daranda Hinkey. 
6          Red  Mountain  is  advised that the  Ninth  Circuit has  held that a  corporation  and 
7 |  other unincorporated associations may only appear in federal court through an attorney. 
8    United States v. High Country Broadcasting Co., Inc., 3 F.3d 1244 (9' Cir. 1993); Licht v. 
9)    America West Airlines, 40 F.3d 1058 (9" Cir. 1994) 
10          DATED:  January 26, 2022  |                                 .
